verdict.rationale: LlamaParse has a dedicated first-party webhooks page. It documents configurable webhook endpoints that are called when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states, replacing polling. That is a registrable outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog and payload schema, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Instead of continuously polling for status updates, you can configure webhook endpoints to be notified immediately when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states.
